title: Characterisation of the classes c_j of a finite locally free sheaf by a single relation on its projective bundle
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises the Chow classes c_j(E) cap alpha of a finite locally free sheaf of rank r on X as the unique classes alpha_j with alpha_0 = alpha satisfying one universal relation on the projective bundle P of E (statement lines 7279-7296, tag 02U6). The proof proves the relation by definition for a single integral class, then reduces a general cycle to that case by passing to the disjoint union of the components, where the projective bundle and its twisting sheaf are the products of the individual ones, and transports the relation back along a proper morphism using flat pullback versus proper pushforward and the projection formula. The transport step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
